title: Linear probing enables Ship-Radiated Noise recognition with pretrained audio embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2601.08358v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Even though the ocean covers the majority of the planet's surface, it remains the least explored ecosystem. As light and radio waves do not propagate through water, underwater acoustics is the main choice for various ocean applications ranging from marine biology to pollution monitoring. Increasing levels of anthropogenic noise from ships contribute significantly to underwater sound pollution, posing risks to marine ecosystems. This makes monitoring crucial to understand and quantify the impact of the ship radiated noise. Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM) systems are widely deployed for this purpose, generating years of underwater recordings across diverse soundscapes. Manual analysis of such large-scale data is impractical, motivating the need for automated approaches based on machine learning. Recent advances in automatic Underwater Acoustic Target Recognition (UATR) have largely relied on supervised learning, which is constrained

translated_title: 线性探测使预训练音频嵌入能够实现船舶辐射噪声识别
translated_abstract: 尽管海洋覆盖了地球表面的大部分区域，但它仍然是探索最少的生态系统。由于光波和无线电波无法在水中传播，水声学成为从海洋生物学到污染监测等各种海洋应用的主要手段。来自船舶的人为噪声日益增多，显著加剧了水下声音污染，对海洋生态系统构成威胁。这使得监测工作对于理解和量化船舶辐射噪声的影响至关重要。被动声学监测（PAM）系统为此目的被广泛部署，产生了跨越多种声景的多年水下录音数据。对如此大规模的数据进行人工分析是不切实际的，这促使人们需要基于机器学习的自动化方法。最近在水下声学目标识别（UATR）方面的进展主要依赖于监督学习，而监督学习受到……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用预训练音频嵌入模型结合线性探测方法实现船舶辐射噪声的自动识别，从而摆脱了传统监督学习对大量标注数据的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that linear probing on pretrained audio embeddings enables effective ship-radiated noise recognition, reducing the reliance on supervised learning with large amounts of labeled data.
